node.title: XR rank-two trades have canonical fundamental-circuit owners
node.statement: For a rank-two uniform split-pencil trade, the Segre coefficient configuration has rank q in {3,4}. Relative to its lexicographically first q-column basis, every non-anchor block has one unique fundamental row-scaling circuit on four or five blocks. These fundamental vectors form a basis of the full scaling kernel and their sum is the original all-one trade vector. Thus every fixed rank-two trade has at most four anchors and canonical intratrade first-match owners; first Maxwell-core selection, support embeddings, cross-core deduplication, and aggregate slope payment remain open.
